_comment: Tier 3 (manual) structural diff recipes for scripts/deps/run-pipelines.sh. Every output uses kind 'tsv-header' with compareColumns [] so only the column header (schema) is compared; value-level drift is expected between a fresh SRA pull and the committed mini fixtures and is reported informationally, not as a failure. Output names use a {sample} placeholder that run-pipelines.sh resolves from --accession into a run-local copy of this manifest, so a sweep against a different accession compares that accession's files rather than reporting every output missing. The committed mini fixtures are named for SRR35517702, so a run against another accession will report the golden as missing (exit 3, a failure) until matching fixtures are added. Golden paths point at the committed mini fixture files directly (goldens.json's {set} substitution is not used here); run-pipelines.sh lays out the candidate directory as <candidate>/<recipe id>/<output name>. See docs/release/dependency-sweep.md step 4 (tier 3).
